svg.aria-description: Parcelpoint's label printing on AWS, from the CDK: 13 nodes, 20 connections. 14 resources on AWS, framed by the construct that declares them and nested in the groups, networks, and subnets that hold them, imported from the AWS CDK. An arrow means one resource refers to another, and its label says how: a role, a private link, logs, or a secret.
svg.font-family: pw-sans-g0qtye6nub, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Parcelpoint's label printing on AWS, from the CDK
svg.desc: Parcelpoint's label printing on AWS, from the CDK: 13 nodes, 20 connections. 14 resources on AWS, framed by the construct that declares them and nested in the groups, networks, and subnets that hold them, imported from the AWS CDK. An arrow means one resource refers to another, and its label says how: a role, a private link, logs, or a secret. Nodes: - Account: AWS account - Resource group: LabelPrinting (Stack) - Resource group: Printing (Construct) - parcel-prod-label-requests-dlq (SQS queue), queue - parcel-prod-label-requests (SQS queue), queue - parcel-prod-label-jobs (DynamoDB), database - parcel-prod-label-renderer (Lambda nodejs22.x), function - Identity: Renderer service role - IAM role, identity - Renderer service role default policy (Policy), identity - Resource group: Alerts (Nested stack) - parcel-prod-label-alerts (SNS topic), queue - Dead letters alarm (Cloudwatch alarm), service - Resource group: API (Construct) - Identity: Intake service role - IAM role, identity - Intake service role default policy (Policy), identity - Application tier: parcel-prod-label-intake - Lambda (nodejs22.x), function - Intake function URL (URL), function - Resource group: LabelStorage (Stack) - parcel-prod-labels (S3 bucket), storage Connections: - parcel-prod-label-requests to parcel-prod-label-requests-dlq (asynchronous line): dead letters - Renderer service role default policy to parcel-prod-label-requests (identity line): messages - Renderer service role default policy to parcel-prod-label-jobs (identity line): data - Renderer service role default policy to parcel-prod-labels (identity line): storage - parcel-prod-label-renderer to Renderer service role default policy (dashed): depends on - parcel-prod-label-renderer to parcel-prod-label-jobs (stored data line): data - parcel-prod-label-renderer to parcel-prod-labels (stored data line): storage - parcel-prod-label-renderer to IAM role (identity line): role - parcel-prod-label-requests to parcel-prod-label-renderer: triggers - Intake service role default policy to parcel-prod-label-requests (identity line): messages - Intake service role default policy to parcel-prod-label-jobs (identity line): data - Intake service role default policy to parcel-prod-labels (identity line): storage - Lambda to Intake service role default policy (dashed): depends on - Lambda to parcel-prod-label-jobs (stored data line): data - Lambda to parcel-prod-labels (stored data line): storage - Lambda to parcel-prod-label-requests (asynchronous line): messages - Lambda to IAM role (identity line): role - Dead letters alarm to parcel-prod-label-alerts (asynchronous line): messages -
